subject: Close cadence triage notebook: last-mile drift, condensed risk matrix, and escalation path
messages:
From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@harmonix.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance window — vendor-side concern

Logan,

Quick note — procurement has surfaced a resourcing constraint on our side: security sign-off for the private deployment is slipping into the week of Dec 6, which bumps our acceptance window by ~2 weeks unless we adjust the MAP. We wanted to surface this early so we can coordinate an alternative gating approach (partial acceptance / feature-gated go-live) rather than moving the whole date.

Can Redwood provide a short risk laundry list and an alternate cutover that preserves the commercial close for Nov 30? Attached is our current MAP (v1.3) plus the procurement redlines we received.

Jamie
CTO — Harmonix Labs
procurement@harmonix.com

Attachments: Harmonix_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (spreadsheet), procurement_terms_v3_redlines.pdf (pdf)

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@harmonix.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP and acceptance window — vendor-side concern

Jamie — thanks for the heads up and the attachments.

High level triage (quick):
- Impact: security sign-off slip -> acceptance moves 2 wks -> commercial close nominally Nov 30 at risk.
- Short-term options: (A) feature-gated acceptance (accept non-PII features Nov 30; hold PII features to Dec 6), (B) contract-level milestone split (close commercial but attach final acceptance clause), (C) limited pilot w/ staging access for key users.

I've pulled a condensed risk matrix (attached: timeline_risk_log_20261120.csv) and sketched a fallback cadence. Laura & Priyom — please validate resource ETA assumptions (security/infra) and call out any gating items we cannot partial-accept.

Next steps: I propose a 30-minute sync Monday 11/23 with Harmonix procurement + security to agree a canary acceptance plan. If Harmonix cannot change their internal sign-off, we'll need to execute the escalation path (see my escalation note below).

Logan
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
log an.wright@redwood.com

Attachments: timeline_risk_log_20261120.csv (csv)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Close cadence triage notebook: quick resource check

Quick checks from infra/security side:
- Security PE estimates: final review queue length is 6 items; current throughput suggests earliest final sign-off 2026-12-06 EOD unless we re-prioritize (requires exec override).
- Workaround feasibility: we can scope a partial acceptance that excludes user PII export and the SSO binding tests; those require the completed security review.
- Risk: partial acceptance introduces operational complexity for Harmonix support (two-mode environment) — needs documented rollback and clear cutover triggers.

I'll attach our prioritized checklist; Laura, can you confirm customer success (CS) bandwidth to run a pilot once partial environment is up?

Priyom
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Jamie Park <jamie.park@harmonix.com>, procurement@harmonix.com
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: ESCALATION: Harmonix close cadence at risk — exec decision requested

Team — summarizing current state and recommended exec asks for Friday Nov 26 leadership call: 

Summary: Harmonix security sign-off delayed to week of Dec 6. Without intervention, acceptance (and therefore go-live) shifts ~2 weeks. Harmonix has asked if we can preserve commercial close Nov 30 via partial acceptance.

Recommended executive actions (short list):
1) Approve a one-time security review priority bump for Harmonix (exec override) to target sign-off by Nov 30. Impact: reallocates a review slot; may delay other queued reviews by ~48 hours.
2) If (1) not approved, approve conditional commercial close with a split milestone (70% payment on Nov 30, remainder on final acceptance) — legal to finalize language.
3) Authorize limited pilot (feature-gated) and a rollback/operational playbook owned by CS/SE (Priyom + Laura).

Attachments: Harmonix_MAP_v1.3.xlsx (customer MAP), procurement_terms_v3_redlines.pdf (procurement redlines), timeline_risk_log_20261120.csv (condensed risk log)

Please reply with decision or a time to talk. If we don't get exec guidance by EOD Tues 11/24 I will open a formal SLA exception request and route to the operations committee.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0193
